# American Red Cross

> The American Red Cross provides disaster relief, blood services, training, emergency preparedness resources, and volunteer opportunities across the United States.

The American Red Cross is a major humanitarian organization serving people affected by disasters and emergencies, supporting blood donation and transfusion needs, teaching lifesaving skills, assisting military families, and helping communities prepare for crises. Its website includes service information, donation pathways, training and certification resources, local chapter tools, and multilingual content.

## Main Site and Navigation
- [American Red Cross Home](https://www.redcross.org/): Main entry point for disaster relief, blood donation, training, volunteering, and giving.
- [Cruz Roja Americana](https://www.redcross.org/cruz-roja.html): Spanish-language hub for Red Cross services, preparedness, and support information.
- [Find Your Local Red Cross](https://www.redcross.org/find-your-local-chapter.html): Search tool for local chapters, offices, and community services.
- [Contact Us](https://www.redcross.org/contact-us.html): Contact options for general inquiries, support, and service-related questions.
- [About Us](https://www.redcross.org/about-us.html): Overview of the organization’s mission, structure, history, and public accountability.
- [Careers](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/careers.html): Employment information, job search resources, and workplace overview.
- [Newsroom](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/news-and-events/news.html): Press releases, announcements, and organizational news updates.

## Disaster Relief and Emergency Assistance
- [Disaster Relief and Recovery](https://www.redcross.org/get-help/disaster-relief-and-recovery-services.html): Central hub for disaster response, recovery support, and emergency assistance.
- [Find Open Shelters](https://www.redcross.org/get-help/disaster-relief-and-recovery-services/find-an-open-shelter.html): Search for open Red Cross shelters during emergencies and disasters.
- [Emergency App](https://www.redcross.org/get-help/how-to-prepare-for-emergencies/mobile-apps.html): Mobile tools for emergency alerts, preparedness, and shelter information.
- [Wildfire Safety](https://www.redcross.org/get-help/how-to-prepare-for-emergencies/types-of-emergencies/wildfire.html): Preparedness, evacuation, and recovery guidance for wildfire emergencies.
- [Hurricane Safety](https://www.redcross.org/get-help/how-to-prepare-for-emergencies/types-of-emergencies/hurricane.html): Safety steps for before, during, and after hurricanes.
- [Flood Safety](https://www.redcross.org/get-help/how-to-prepare-for-emergencies/types-of-emergencies/flood.html): Flood preparedness, response, and cleanup guidance.
- [Tornado Safety](https://www.redcross.org/get-help/how-to-prepare-for-emergencies/types-of-emergencies/tornado.html): Tornado readiness and response recommendations for households and communities.
- [Earthquake Safety](https://www.redcross.org/get-help/how-to-prepare-for-emergencies/types-of-emergencies/earthquake.html): Earthquake preparation and post-event safety information.

## Preparedness and Safety Education
- [How to Prepare for Emergencies](https://www.redcross.org/get-help/how-to-prepare-for-emergencies.html): Preparedness guidance for common emergencies and household planning.
- [Make a Plan](https://www.redcross.org/get-help/how-to-prepare-for-emergencies/make-a-plan.html): Instructions for creating family emergency communication and evacuation plans.
- [Build a Kit](https://www.redcross.org/get-help/how-to-prepare-for-emergencies/survival-kit-supplies.html): Recommended emergency supply kit contents for homes and travel.
- [Home Fire Campaign](https://www.redcross.org/local/home-fire-campaign.html): Fire prevention, smoke alarm, and home safety initiative information.
- [Pet Disaster Preparedness](https://www.redcross.org/get-help/how-to-prepare-for-emergencies/pet-disaster-preparedness.html): Emergency planning guidance for pets and animal safety.
- [Water Safety for Children and Families](https://www.redcross.org/take-a-class/resources/water-safety.html): Water safety education and prevention resources for families.
- [First Aid Steps](https://www.redcross.org/take-a-class/first-aid/performing-first-aid.html): Basic first aid guidance for common injuries and emergencies.

## Blood Donation and Biomedical Services
- [Give Blood](https://www.redcrossblood.org/): Blood donation portal for appointments, eligibility, and donor resources.
- [Find a Blood Drive](https://www.redcrossblood.org/give.html/find-drive): Search for nearby blood drives and donation appointments.
- [Blood Donation Process](https://www.redcrossblood.org/donate-blood/blood-donation-process.html): Step-by-step overview of what donors can expect during donation.
- [Eligibility Requirements](https://www.redcrossblood.org/donate-blood/how-to-donate/eligibility-requirements.html): General blood donor eligibility criteria and participation rules.
- [Types of Blood Donations](https://www.redcrossblood.org/donate-blood/how-to-donate/types-of-blood-donations.html): Overview of whole blood, platelet, plasma, and Power Red donations.
- [RapidPass](https://www.redcrossblood.org/rapidpass.html): Pre-donation health history tool to speed up the donation process.
- [Blood Donor App](https://www.redcrossblood.org/blood-donor-app.html): Mobile app for managing appointments, tracking donations, and receiving alerts.
- [Biomedical Services](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/our-work/biomedical-services.html): Overview of Red Cross blood collection and biomedical operations.

## Training, Certification, and Classes
- [Take a Class](https://www.redcross.org/take-a-class): Main hub for CPR, first aid, lifeguarding, and instructor training.
- [CPR Classes and Certification](https://www.redcross.org/take-a-class/cpr): CPR course options, formats, and certification information.
- [First Aid Classes](https://www.redcross.org/take-a-class/first-aid): First aid training options for individuals and workplaces.
- [BLS Training](https://www.redcross.org/take-a-class/bls-training): Basic Life Support courses for healthcare and professional responders.
- [Lifeguarding](https://www.redcross.org/take-a-class/lifeguarding): Lifeguard certification and recertification course information.
- [Babysitting and Child Care](https://www.redcross.org/take-a-class/babysitting-child-care): Babysitting training and child care preparedness courses.
- [Instructor Training](https://www.redcross.org/take-a-class/instructor-training): Programs for becoming a Red Cross instructor.
- [Training for Organizations](https://www.redcross.org/take-a-class/training-for-organizations): Workplace and group training solutions for employers and institutions.

## Military, Veterans, and International Services
- [Service to the Armed Forces](https://www.redcross.org/get-help/military-families.html): Emergency communication, support, and assistance for military members and families.
- [Emergency Communication Messages](https://www.redcross.org/get-help/military-families/emergency-communication.html): Information on urgent Red Cross messaging for military families.
- [Veterans and Military Caregiver Support](https://www.redcross.org/get-help/military-families/services-for-veterans.html): Programs and support resources for veterans and caregivers.
- [International Services](https://www.redcross.org/get-help/international-services.html): Help with family tracing, emergencies abroad, and humanitarian services.
- [Restoring Family Links](https://www.redcross.org/get-help/international-services/restoring-family-links.html): Assistance reconnecting families separated by conflict, disaster, or migration.
- [Refugee and Immigration Services](https://www.redcross.org/get-help/international-services/refugee-services.html): Information on selected humanitarian support for refugees and migrants.

## Volunteer and Community Involvement
- [Volunteer with the Red Cross](https://www.redcross.org/volunteer/volunteer-opportunities.html): Volunteer roles, requirements, and application pathways.
- [Volunteer FAQ](https://www.redcross.org/volunteer/volunteer-faq.html): Answers to common questions about volunteering and onboarding.
- [Youth Involvement](https://www.redcross.org/volunteer/become-a-volunteer/youth-opportunities.html): Volunteer and leadership opportunities for youth and young adults.
- [Disaster Action Team](https://www.redcross.org/volunteer/become-a-volunteer/disaster-action-team.html): Information about local disaster response volunteer roles.
- [Corporate and Community Partnerships](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/partnerships.html): Partnership opportunities for companies and community organizations.
- [Local Events](https://www.redcross.org/local.html): Access to local chapter pages, events, and regional activities.

## Donations and Ways to Give
- [Donate Now](https://www.redcross.org/donate/donation.html/): Main donation page for one-time and recurring charitable gifts.
- [Ways to Donate](https://www.redcross.org/donations/ways-to-donate.html): Overview of available giving methods and donation options.
- [Monthly Giving](https://www.redcross.org/donations/ways-to-donate/monthly-giving.html): Recurring donation program information and supporter benefits.
- [Planned Giving](https://www.redcross.org/donations/ways-to-donate/planned-giving.html): Estate, legacy, and beneficiary-based charitable giving options.
- [Stocks and Mutual Funds](https://www.redcross.org/donations/ways-to-donate/stocks-mutual-funds.html): Instructions for donating appreciated securities and related assets.
- [Donor-Advised Funds](https://www.redcross.org/donations/ways-to-donate/donor-advised-funds.html): Guidance for recommending grants through donor-advised fund providers.
- [Qualified Charitable Distributions](https://www.redcross.org/donations/ways-to-donate/qualified-charitable-distributions.html): IRA charitable distribution information for eligible donors.
- [Text, Mail, or Phone Donations](https://www.redcross.org/donations/ways-to-donate/text-mail-phone.html): Alternative donation methods beyond online giving.

- [Leadership](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/who-we-are/leadership.html): Executive and governance leadership information.
- [Board of Governors](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/who-we-are/board-of-governors.html): Governance board details and organizational oversight information.
- [Financial Statements](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/who-we-are/financial-statements.html): Financial reporting and accountability documents for donors and the public.
- [Annual Report](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/who-we-are/publications-and-annual-reports.html): Annual reports and publications describing impact and operations.
- [Volunteer Leadership and Governance](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/who-we-are/our-governance.html): Information about governance structure and volunteer leadership roles.

- [Blog and Stories](https://www.redcross.org/about-us/news-and-events/news.html): Organizational stories, response updates, and public-interest content.
